messages:
jamie: quick heads-up — flipping a temporary routing for batch-gpu-high-latency alerts to #eng-infra for a cooldown window tonight 23:00-02:00 PT. this is to avoid noisy pages while we apply a kernel patch to a subset of nodes. will revert automatically at 02:00 PT. @mike can you be the fallback if something slips? :pray:

sara: got it. are we silencing or rerouting? want to make sure ops retains visibility.

jamie: rerouting only — alerts will go to eng-infra channel and escalation still goes through normal pager after 10m. not muting. config snippet:
```
route: if alert.labels.group == "batch-gpu" and severity == "warning" then route_to:eng-infra
squelch: false
escalation_delay: 600
```
runbook: https://go/runbooks/batch-gpu

ben: leaving a note — I'll be available until 00:30 PT, can take initial triage if @mike is busy.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: kernel-patch-batch-gpu v2 -> starting 23:15 PT, expected duration ~45m. No automated rollback set. :rotating_light:

jamie: thanks @ben. if anyone sees sustained errors after patch (>5% error rate for 10m) we revert routing and open a post-check. Plan B: patch-hosts offlined one-by-one.

olivia: can you drop the exact alert IDs? want to filter them for dashboards.

jamie: sure — alert_ids: ["BGPU_LAT_1", "BGPU_ERR_2"]. I'll push a PR to alerting-config in a sec: https://git/repo/alerts/pulls/42

mike: @jamie I'm on standby from 23:00-01:00 PT. if you don't hear back from me ping @sara. :thumbsup:

sara: noted. adding a short note to oncall doc about this window.

jamie: thanks all — logging this here to make oncall handoff easier. will post a short follow-up once routing reverts.
